story.title: The Broken Oath of Ironreach and Goldcrest
story.last: Men without banners burn House Ironreach's farms from Goldrock to the river. Everyone knows whose men they are.

beats.text: Cecily Goldcrest's daughter, wed to House Ironreach by the King's own blessing, dies in childbed at Saltkeep. House Goldcrest says the midwives were Ysolde Ironreach's creatures. Cecily: "I will have the Ironreach family brought to the court, and I will demand that Ysolde be brought before the High Council for trial."

counsel.why: Elsbeth Thornvale: "You ruled against us at court, in the winter of 315. Set that right, or Thornvale raises its banners." Answer with a favour they can see; silence is a refusal.

counsel.text: House Thornvale and House Stormhold are at war
counsel.why: Every season of war burns fields and lowers the realm's peace. House Thornvale is cold to the crown: made to stop, it will resent it, and the blood-price comes dearer. Or bind the two by marriage.
